kinds.name: coqui_authenticator
kinds.doc: Checks credentials and returns only a [`Lookup`] reference.

slots.name: authenticate
slots.doc:
Checks one attempt without returning person details or credential material.

An error means the authenticator could not find out; it is never a verdict.

slots.name: describe
slots.doc: What this authenticator is and what it takes. Defaults to nothing said.

kinds.name: coqui_directory
kinds.doc: Resolves an authenticated reference into the authoritative [`Person`] record.

slots.name: lookup
slots.doc:
Returns the person for `lookup`, or `None` when the reference is unknown or the
account is disabled.

slots.name: describe
slots.doc: What this directory is. Defaults to nothing said.

kinds.name: coqui_authorizer
kinds.doc: Authorizes one action on one resource for a [`Person`] a directory returned.

slots.name: authorize
slots.doc: Evaluates the request using the supplied authoritative person record.

kinds.name: coqui_accounts
kinds.doc:
Account management for a provider that keeps its own accounts.

A separate kind, so authentication providers that keep nothing (an LDAP client, a
reverse-proxy header reader) do not implement it. A provider offering this kind is
usually also an [`Authenticator`] and a [`Directory`] over the same store.

slots.name: accounts
slots.doc: The accounts kept, without anything that proves one.

slots.name: put
slots.doc:
Makes an account, or changes the one of that name; a field not said is left as it
is. A provider that makes secrets itself answers with the one it made.

slots.name: remove
slots.doc: Takes an account away. `GUATIAO_ERR_NOT_FOUND` when none has that name.

slots.name: waiting
slots.doc:
What was shown lately and is nobody's yet, and could be accepted as somebody's with
[`put`](Accounts::put): a peer certificate nobody has accepted. Empty for a
provider that keeps no such thing.
